about.whoWeAreBody: {{appName}} ndi wailesi yamakono yomwe imakubweretserani mapulogalamu a live, ma podcast osankhidwa, nkhani zadzidzidzi, ndi kulumikizana ndi oyimba ndi mapulogalamu omwe mumakonda — zonse mu app imodzi. Kaya mukumvera pa live, kupitiriza buku la podcast popanda intaneti, kapena kupempha nyimbo yomwe mumakonda, tili pano kukusungani mogwirizana ndi mawu a dera lanu, kulikonse kumene muli.
about.missionBody: Kudziwitsa, kusangalatsa, ndi kulumikiza omvera athu kudzera mu wailesi ya live yosangalatsa, ma podcast athu eni, ndi nkhani za nthawi yeniyeni — mothandizidwa ndi ubwino ndi kudalirika komwe omvera amakono amayembekezera, pa chipangizo chilichonse chomwe asankha.
